about_the_game:
What is Necrosis: Dawn of Dread?
Necrosis: Dawn of Dread is a tense, first-person co-op survival horror experience that blends the claustrophobic dread of old-school horror games with modern gameplay mechanics. Team up with up to three friends to scavenge supplies, survive brutal encounters, and solve deadly puzzles in a city overwhelmed by the undead. Every match is a desperate fight to survive—with no second chances.

Key Features

Terrifying Co-op Survival Horror

Experience classic survival horror from a new angle. NDOD drops you into large, unpredictable environments filled with relentless enemies, dwindling resources, and no guarantees. The only way out… is together.

Tactical FPS Combat

Manage limited ammo, choose your shots carefully, and master a variety of weapons. NDOD rewards precision and teamwork—reckless shooting will only get you killed.

Engaging Puzzles

Solve layered, interactive puzzles that challenge your observation and deduction skills. These are designed to keep you thinking and actively involved in every mission.

Twelve Unique Characters

Choose your squad from a roster of twelve distinct survivors, each with a unique role and special ability—healing, melee takedowns, enemy debuffs, starting gear, and more. Mix and match characters to find the ideal team synergy.
Discover and unlock additional secret characters as you progress, each bringing new tactics and surprises to your survival toolkit.

Massive Replayable Levels

Explore fifteen large environments inspired by survival horror classics. From hospitals to city streets, every location is filled with atmosphere, threats, and secrets to discover.

Randomized Encounters

No two sessions are the same. Enemy placements, item locations, and some puzzles change each time you play. The experience stays fresh no matter how often you return.

Built for Replayability

Session-based design means you can drop in for a quick run or settle in for a night of survival. Perfect for both casual and hardcore co-op players.

Additional Features

  • Automatcher Queue – Match with other survivors and use proximity VOIP or text chat to coordinate your escape.

  • Single Player Mode – Play solo if you prefer, but NDOD is best experienced in co-op.

  • Achievements & Unlockables – No microtransactions. Unlock cosmetics and rewards through gameplay, not payments.

  • Leaderboards – Compete for the fastest clears and prove your survival skills.

  • Long-Term Roadmap – Additional levels, characters, and enemies planned post-launch—all free.

  • No DRM. No Third-Party Accounts. – Just buy the game and play. No logins, no restrictions.

A Game That Respects You

Necrosis: Dawn of Dread is developed by a small, independent team with no corporate backing and no interest in exploitative practices. No microtransactions. No always-online requirement. No nonsense. Just pure survival horror—built for players who love the genre.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card
  • Storage: 21 GB available space

short_description: Trapped. Hunted. Running low on ammo. Necrosis: Dawn of Dread is a brutal first-person survival horror game where cooperation is your only hope. Explore a decaying city overrun by the dead. Scavenge supplies, solve deadly puzzles, and fight your way to freedom—with or without your friends.
